root_cause.text: do_swap_page() spins on folio_trylock() in a busy-wait loop to acquire the lock of a device-private folio during migration, which can lead to a livelock when the lock holder is blocked waiting for a work item (e.g., via lru_add_drain_all()) on the same CPU, preventing progress.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "If hmm_range_fault() fails a folio_trylock() in do_swap_page, ... the function will spin until it succeeds grabbing the lock." and that this can cause starvation when the lock holder depends on a work item scheduled on the same CPU. The patch replaces the spinning with a proper wait using `softleaf_entry_wait_on_locked()` which blocks the task instead of busy-waiting.
